body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended The retry + fail-fast behavior is consistently applied, error paths now stop before checksum/extraction, and CI adds deterministic regression coverage for the new logic.
Pull request overview This PR hardens sb-manager’s core asset download path (sing-box + cloudflared) against transient network failures by implementing full retry + fail-fast behavior, and adds deterministic regression coverage to prevent partial/empty downloads from proceeding into checksum/extraction. **Changes:** - Add a reusable `download_file_with_retries` helper and apply it to sing-box/cloudflared downloads; delete partial files and stop immediately on final failure or empty downloads. - Make GitHub Release API queries fully retried, validate required fields (e.g., `tag_name`), and fix `latest` lookup control-flow to avoid silently treating `latest` as a version. - Add deterministic retry/fail-fast smoke tests and wire them into CI; bump version/docs/changelog to `0.1.0-alpha.6`.
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | VERSION | Bumps project version to `0.1.0-alpha.6`. | | lib/common.sh | Updates the default `SBM_VERSION` fallback to `0.1.0-alpha.6`. | | lib/core.sh | Implements download retry + fail-fast logic and applies it to sing-box/cloudflared + GitHub API lookups. | | tests/download-retry-smoke.sh | Adds deterministic coverage for retry success and permanent-failure cleanup behavior. | | tests/install-smoke.sh | Updates installer smoke test to assert the new version string. | | .github/workflows/ci.yml | Adds the new retry smoke test to CI and strengthens CI curl retry behavior. | | README.md | Updates the displayed current version. | | CHANGELOG.md | Documents the retry/fail-fast behavior changes for `0.1.0-alpha.6`. |
Review details - **Files reviewed:** 8/8 changed files - **Comments generated:** 0 - **Review effort level:** Lite
